description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of AMPA selective glutamate receptor activity. [GOC:BHF]
label: REGULATION OF AMPA RECEPTOR ACTIVITY *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of neurotransmitter receptor activity. Modulation may be via an effect on ligand affinity, or effector function such as ion selectivity or pore opening/closing in ionotropic receptors. [GOC:dos]
label: REGULATION OF NEUROTRANSMITTER RECEPTOR ACTIVITY *

description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a type I interferon stimulus. Type I interferons include the interferon-alpha, beta, delta, episilon, zeta, kappa, tau, and omega gene families. [GOC:add, ISBN:0126896631, PMID:15546383, PMID:16681834]
label: RESPONSE TO TYPE I INTERFERON *

description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide by hydrolysis of its peptide bonds that is mediated by the proteasome. [GOC:tb]
label: PROTEASOMAL PROTEIN CATABOLIC PROCESS *

description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide by hydrolysis of its peptide bonds, initiated by the covalent attachment of ubiquitin, and mediated by the proteasome. [GOC:go_curators]
label: PROTEASOME MEDIATED UBIQUITIN DEPENDENT PROTEIN CATABOLIC PROCESS *

description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of small molecules, any low molecular weight, monomeric, non-encoded molecule. [GOC:curators, GOC:pde, GOC:vw]
label: SMALL MOLECULE BIOSYNTHETIC PROCESS *

description: Progression through the phases of the mitotic cell cycle, the most common eukaryotic cell cycle, which canonically comprises four successive phases called G1, S, G2, and M and includes replication of the genome and the subsequent segregation of chromosomes into daughter cells. In some variant cell cycles nuclear replication or nuclear division may not be followed by cell division, or G1 and G2 phases may be absent. [GOC:mah, ISBN:0815316194]
label: MITOTIC CELL CYCLE *

description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a macromolecule, initiated by covalent modification of the target molecule. [GOC:jl]
label: MODIFICATION DEPENDENT MACROMOLECULE CATABOLIC PROCESS *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the immune response, the immunological reaction of an organism to an immunogenic stimulus. [GOC:ai]
label: REGULATION OF IMMUNE RESPONSE *

description: A change in morphology and behavior of a lymphocyte resulting from exposure to a specific antigen, mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or soluble factor. [GOC:mgi_curators, ISBN:0781735149]
label: LYMPHOCYTE ACTIVATION *

description: The appearance of a cytokine due to biosynthesis or secretion following a cellular stimulus, resulting in an increase in its intracellular or extracellular levels. [GOC:add, ISBN:0781735149]
label: CYTOKINE PRODUCTION *

description: The attachment of one cell to another cell via adhesion molecules. [GOC:dos]
label: CELL CELL ADHESION *

description: The immediate defensive reaction (by vertebrate tissue) to infection or injury caused by chemical or physical agents. The process is characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages. [GO_REF:0000022, ISBN:0198506732]
label: INFLAMMATORY RESPONSE *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of cell activation, the change in the morphology or behavior of a cell resulting from exposure to an activating factor such as a cellular or soluble ligand. [GOC:ai]
label: REGULATION OF CELL ACTIVATION *

description: The change in morphology and behavior of a mature or immature T cell resulting from exposure to a mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or an antigen for which it is specific. [GOC:mgi_curators, ISBN:0781735149]
label: T CELL ACTIVATION *

description: Any process of the immune system that executes a component of an immune response. An effector immune process takes place after its activation. [GO_REF:0000022, GOC:add, ISBN:0781735149]
label: IMMUNE EFFECTOR PROCESS *
